title: Нам надо поговорить  (We Need to Talk)

segments.t: In the restaurant, Nastya stops Kostya because she wants to have a very serious conversation, and we will listen to their dialogue in Russian first; do not worry about catching every single word.
Настя, я так по тебе соскучился.
Но нам надо обсудить наше будущее.
Now let's go back through the exchange around We Need to Talk line by line and unpack how the Russian works.
'Kostya, we have to talk.' Russian expresses this impersonally, literally saying 'to me' or 'to you' with 'to talk'. Then Kostya replies.
'Can it wait?' Russian forms this yes-or-no question without a question word, relying on rising pitch on 'to wait'.
'No, it is important.' Nastya delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'important'.
Настя, я так по тебе соскучился.
'Nastya, I have missed you so much.' Notice the self-directed ending on the verb for 'missed', which directs the action back onto the subject.
'Please, listen to me.' Nastya leads with the direct command form meaning 'listen' to make the point directly in conversation.
'I am listening to you.' Kostya delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'I'm listening'.
'Our relationship is moving fast.' Notice the self-directed ending on the verb for 'develop', which directs the action back onto the subject. Then Kostya responds.
'I think this is great.' Notice how naturally this everyday Russian phrase expresses the speaker's point.
Но нам надо обсудить наше будущее.
'But we need to discuss our future.' Nastya puts the word for 'it is necessary' together with 'to discuss' and 'future' in a crisp, natural spoken turn of phrase.
'We have a lot of time.' Kostya uses the classic Russian possession phrasing — literally 'at us' rather than a verb meaning 'to have', combining 'there is' with 'a lot' and 'time'.
'No, the time is now.' The phrasing opens with 'time' before bringing in 'to come' and 'now' to make the point clear.
'Okay, I am ready to talk.' Kostya expresses this naturally by combining the word for 'good' with 'ready' and 'to talk'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
Настя, я так по тебе соскучился.
Но нам надо обсудить наше будущее.

Kostya finally realizes that he cannot avoid this serious conversation with her. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'it is necessary' and 'to have a talk' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
